finite_sample_correction.quantile_method: higher order statistic after sorting finite residuals

fallback_policy.behavior: fail explicitly if the chronological split, model fit, or finite residual quantile is unavailable

shared_forecaster_scope.fit_cutoff: purged training block only; no calibration or test fitting of base/risk model

base_interval.construction: numpy.quantile of the individual tree point predictions, not leaf-response quantiles
base_interval.indicator_scope: columns missing during imputer fitting; explicit family fractions also recomputed
base_interval.subsampling: deterministic evenly spaced row indices using numpy.linspace, not random sampling
base_interval.augmentation_partition: one seeded permutation; selected rows partitioned across the four degraded conditions
base_interval.clipping: base endpoints before scores and expanded endpoints to [0, capacity]

risk_model.label: abs(y[t+h]-y[t])/capacity >= nominal threshold for the horizon
risk_model.probability: class-1 probability from predict_proba; both classes verified in all 40 saved runs
risk_model.strata: four quantile bins of pooled calibration risks across all five conditions
risk_model.ties: numpy.digitize(..., right=True); repeated edges may leave empty bins

sensitivity_scope.ramp: post-run relabeling of saved nominal-threshold predictions using exact raw power differences
sensitivity_scope.unchanged: ramp training weights, risk labels/model, calibrators, future-label reference, thresholds/gates
sensitivity_scope.limitation: not a comparison of pipelines retrained at alternative ramp definitions

coverage_denominators.attempted: target-evaluable saved prediction rows, including unavailable prediction tuples
coverage_denominators.issued: rows with finite median, lower and upper
coverage_denominators.service_coverage: covered / attempted; unavailable attempts count as uncovered
coverage_denominators.primary: requires complete availability for baseline and three candidates
coverage_denominators.natural_missingness: four primary methods; naturally missing features in clean-condition predictions only
coverage_denominators.exclusions: missing current power or future target not included; no evidence on those origins
